title: Bytecode and the Interpreter
summary: Follow source to code object to .pyc, watch the specializing adaptive interpreter rewrite instructions for the types it sees, and place the experimental JIT and free threading in that picture. Decide what tools may rely on, and why bytecode is never one of those things.
